purpose: Extract auditable page-scoped text from already validated official filing PDF bytes so the AI-Core classifier never consumes search snippets, titles, OCR guesses, or unproven source text.

required: canonical_security_id and announcement_id are bound to the object

extraction.normalize: Unicode text preserved; line-ending and redundant whitespace normalization allowed; semantic rewriting forbidden

problem_elimination.delete: Do not OCR every filing by default.
problem_elimination.avoid: Do not let search-result title/highlight text enter the classifier.
problem_elimination.absorb: Use the PDF's embedded text layer when present.
problem_elimination.substitute: If the entire filing lacks an extractable text layer, block that filing instead of launching an expensive automatic OCR workflow.
problem_elimination.precompute_reuse: Cache compact page-text extraction by raw PDF object SHA256.
problem_elimination.optimize: OCR may only be considered later as a separately frozen exception path if material coverage proves it necessary.
